# ViraStack

> DX-first open-source toolkit for React frontend developers: production starters, agent architecture rules, headless form hooks, and an interactive modern-web guide. MIT licensed.

Prefer product `llms-full.txt` files for API detail. Use this file as the curated ecosystem map. Primary language for docs and packages is English.

Package versions (approx.): `virastack@1.1.0`, `@virastack/mask@2.1.0`, `@virastack/password@1.1.0`, `@virastack/ai@2.0.0`.

## Products

- [Start](https://virastack.com/start): CLI (`npx virastack@latest`) to scaffold Next.js or TanStack Start apps
- [AI](https://virastack.com/ai): Architecture rules for Claude Code, Cursor and AGENTS.md (`npx @virastack/ai init`)
- [Mask](https://virastack.com/mask): Zero-dependency input masks for React Hook Form (`@virastack/mask`)
- [Password](https://virastack.com/password): Accessible password hook: show/hide, NIST-style strength, confirmation, server validation (`@virastack/password`)
- [Address](https://virastack.com/address): Headless Turkish address hook: province, district, neighbourhood and postal code (`@virastack/address`)
- [Guide](https://virastack.com/guide): Interactive “modern web” walkthrough

## Human docs

- [Start docs](https://virastack.com/start/docs): Install, CLI, templates, scripts, i18n
- [AI docs](https://virastack.com/ai/docs): Install, CLI, installed files, rules, upgrade from v1
- [Mask docs](https://virastack.com/mask/docs): Hook, custom masks, validation, server, helpers, examples
- [Password docs](https://virastack.com/password/docs): Hook, strength, confirm, React Hook Form, server, leaked passwords, examples
- [Address docs](https://virastack.com/address/docs): Hook, React Hook Form, UI libraries, server, data, helpers

## Packages

- [`virastack`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/virastack): Scaffold CLI (Start)
- [`@virastack/ai`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@virastack/ai): Shared agent rules for scaffolds
- [`@virastack/mask`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@virastack/mask): Input masks for React + React Hook Form
- [`@virastack/password`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@virastack/password): Accessible password hook for React (show/hide, strength, server validation)
- [`@virastack/address`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@virastack/address): Headless Turkish address hook for React (il, ilçe, mahalle, postal code)
